corrections.caveats: Enricher: the CMSIS-DSP version and FFT function used in the post are unknown. SYLT-FFT's 15-26% win was against the deprecated arm_cfft_radix2_q31 (CMSIS-DSP 1.4.2), not the current arm_cfft_q31. The Q31 FFT output is down-shifted (by 11.21 bits at 1024 points), so outputs need rescaling before comparison. arm_rfft_fast_f32 overwrites its input (#228); Neon builds use a different CFFT/RFFT API; the README asks for -O3 -ffast-math and an FPU-enabled target.
